scope: Offline independent ENG numeric unit, architecture, fuel literal/rowspan, and transmission evidence audit. No live fetches, no repository changes.
interpretation: Candidate-row unit tuple match is only a source observation. All trim/year joins stay review_required. Frame-only matches and missing qualifiers are not verified joins; absence from ENG does not prove a value false.
normalization: Whitespace/NBSP normalized only for typed fuel comparisons.
I/L/l/R architecture letters explicitly converted to inline I, preserving cylinder count and displacement numeric token.
Hyb4 remains Hyb4; no architecture inference from the word hybrid.
Fuel 하이브리드 and 가솔린+전기 treated as normalized broad equivalents, never literal equivalents.
Added engine qualifiers independently checked against candidate row.
